name: praxis
description: A lean engineering framework with optional stations, durable initiative context, evolutionary delivery, human control modes, and evidence-matched assurance.

interface.shortDescription: A lean engineering framework for capable agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis is one loop with optional stations — EXPLORE, DECIDE, CONTRACT, PLAN, EXECUTE, PROVE, DELIVER — where one station owns the current question and ordinary work stays direct. Campaign keeps long-running initiative truth durable without forcing delivery. Manually invoked Evolve maps accepted direction into vertical working forms and executes one authorized evolution at a time; Pair and Orient independently control collaboration and explanation. Its assurance ladder adds delegation or independent review only for a concrete ownership advantage or named risk, and human gates protect accepted plans and plan-governed pull requests.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route one Praxis station, preserve applicable durable context, honor explicitly invoked strategy or modes, and keep ordinary work direct.
